text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан's performance certainly
impresses the
spectators, but she is
thoroughly exhausted
afterward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
According to her older sister, Biwa
Hayahide,
Brian wasn't running like
normal.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I investigate the data I have on Narita
Brian to
find the cause and learn that her
experience
racing against multiple
opponents is lacking.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This discovery could draw attention to
her
weakness. We need to overcome it
by the Asahi
Hai Futurity Stakes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
